physicochemical.name: MaxRing
physicochemical.explanation:
Number of atoms in the biggest ring.
Optimal:0~18

physicochemical.name: logS
physicochemical.explanation: The logarithm of aqueous solubility value.

physicochemical.name: logP
physicochemical.explanation: The logarithm of the n-octanol/water distribution coefficients.

physicochemical.name: logD
physicochemical.explanation: The logarithm of the n-octanol/water distribution coefficient at pH=7.4.

physicochemical.name: pka_acidic
physicochemical.explanation: Acid-base dissociation constant (pKa) value represents the strength of a drug molecule's acidity or basicity.

physicochemical.name: pka_basic
physicochemical.explanation: Acid-base dissociation constant (pKa) value represents the strength of a drug molecule's acidity or basicity.

physicochemical.name: mp
physicochemical.explanation:
The predicted melting point of a compound is expressed in degrees Celsius (°C).
Melting points below 25°C are classified as liquids, while melting points above 25°C are classified as solids.

physicochemical.name: bp
physicochemical.explanation:
The predicted melting point of a compound is expressed in degrees Celsius (°C).
A normal boiling point below 25°C is categorized as a gas.

medchem.name: QED
medchem.explanation:
A measure of drug-likeness based on the concept of desirability;
Attractive: > 0.67;
unattractive: 0.49~0.67;
too complex: < 0.34

medchem.name: Synth
medchem.explanation:
Synthetic accessibility score is designed to estimate ease of synthesis of drug-like molecules.
SAscore ≥ 6, difficult to synthesize; SAscore <6, easy to synthesize

medchem.name: gasa
medchem.explanation:
ES: Easy to synthesize; HS: Hard to synthesize;
The output value represents the probability of being difficult to synthesize, ranging from 0 to 1.

medchem.name: Fsp3
medchem.explanation:
The number of sp3 hybridized carbons / total carbon count, correlating with melting point and solubility.
Fsp3 ≥0.42 is considered a suitable value.

medchem.name: MCE-18
medchem.explanation:
MCE-18 stands for medicinal chemistry evolution.
MCE-18≥45 is considered a suitable value.

medchem.name: Natural Product-likeness
medchem.explanation:
Natural product-likeness score.
This score is typically in the range from -5 to 5.
The higher the score is, the higher the probability is that the molecule is a NP.

medchem.name: Lipinski
medchem.explanation:
MW ≤ 500; logP ≤ 5; Hacc ≤ 10; Hdon ≤ 5
If two properties are out of range, a poor absorption or permeability is possible, one is acceptable.

medchem.name: Pfizer
medchem.explanation:
logP > 3; TPSA < 75
Compounds with a high log P (>3) and low TPSA (<75) are likely to be toxic.

medchem.name: GSK
medchem.explanation:
MW ≤ 400; logP ≤ 4
Compounds satisfying the GSK rule may have a more favorable ADMET profile

medchem.name: GoldenTriangle
medchem.explanation:
200 ≤ MW ≤ 500; -2 ≤ logD ≤ 5
Compounds satisfying the Golden Triangle rule may have a more favorable ADMET profile.

medchem.name: PAINS
medchem.explanation: frequent hitters, Alpha-screen artifacts and reactive compound 480 substructures (J Med Chem 201053:2719-40)

medchem.name: Alarm_NMR
medchem.explanation: Thiol reactive compounds.

medchem.name: BMS
medchem.explanation: undesirable, reactive compounds 176 substructures (J Chem Inf Model 200646:1060-8)

medchem.name: Chelating
medchem.explanation: Chelating compounds.

medchem.name: Aggregators
medchem.explanation:
Category 0: non-colloidal aggregators;
Category 1: colloidal aggregators.
The output value is the probability of being colloidal aggregators, within the range of 0 to 1.

medchem.name: Fluc
medchem.explanation:
Category 0: non-fLuc inhibitors;
Category 1: fLuc inhibitors.
The output value is the probability of being fLuc inhibitors, within the range of 0 to 1.

medchem.name: Blue_fluorescence

medchem.name: Green_fluorescence

medchem.name: Reactive
medchem.explanation:

medchem.name: Promiscuous
medchem.explanation:

Category 1: promiscuous compound.
The output value is the probability of being promiscuous compound, within the range of 0 to 1.

absorption.name: MDCK
absorption.explanation:
low permeability: < 2 × 10-6 cm/s
medium permeability: 2-20 × 10-6 cm/s
high passive permeability: > 20 × 10-6 cm/s

absorption.name: PAMPA
absorption.explanation:
The experimental data for Peff was logarithmically transformed (logPeff).
Molecules with log Peff values below 2.0 were classified as low-permeability (Category 0), while those with log Peff values exceeding 2.5 were classified as high-permeability (Category 1).

Category 0: Non-inhibitor;
The output value is the probability of being Pgp-inhibitor

absorption.name: pgp_sub
absorption.explanation:
Category 1: substrate;
Category 0: Non-substrate;
The output value is the probability of being Pgp-substrate

absorption.name: hia

Category 0: HIA-( HIA >= 30%);
The output value is the probability of being HIA+

absorption.name: f20

distribution.name: BBB

distribution.name: Fu

excretion.name: cl-plasma
excretion.explanation:

>15 ml/min/kg: high clearance;
5-15 ml/min/kg: moderate clearance;
< 5 ml/min/kg: low clearance.

excretion.name: t0.5
excretion.explanation:

ultra-short half-life drugs: 1/2 < 1 hour;
short half-life drugs: T1/2 between 1-4 hours;
intermediate short half-life drugs: T1/2 between 4-8 hours;
long half-life drugs: T1/2 > 8 hours.

toxicity.name: hERG
toxicity.explanation:
Molecules with IC50 ≤10μM or ≥50% inhibition at 10 μM were classified as hERG+ (Category 1),
while molecules with IC50 >10μM or < 50% inhibition at 10μM were classified as hERG - (Category 0).
The output value is the probability of being hERG+, within the range of 0 to 1.

toxicity.name: hERG-10um
toxicity.explanation:

and molecules with IC50 > 10μM are classified as hERG- (Category 0).
The output value is the probability of being hERG+, within the range of 0 to 1.
